name: Evil Empire Designs, Inc.
summary: Based in Henderson, Nevada, Evil Empire Designs, Inc. specializes in crafting and providing bespoke parts and accessories for both Harley Davidson and metric motorcycles. The company is deeply engaged in the aftermarket motorcycle industry, handling the entire process from designing and manufacturing to marketing and selling various products. Their offerings include custom motorcycle body components, precision-machined billet aluminum parts and accessories, aftermarket handlebars, and a range of apparel. Incorporated in 2009, the firm operated under the name US Terra Energy Corp until September 2016, when it officially adopted its current identity, Evil Empire Designs, Inc.
